scope: Read-only audit of public Airscope sources for three proposed BrainPilotBench mouse tasks; no task or evaluator code changed.
source_observations: The pinned Neuron-BERT README documents tube-test win/lose prediction from dual-animal calcium signals and expects trial records in data_aligned.pkl with winner and time_start_end fields. Its reported five-fold result includes F1.

The pinned dataset code yields one sample per trial, sets label 1 when the first mouse in the pair is the winner, and swaps animal order with label inversion only during training. The pinned metric code calls sklearn f1_score with average='binary'.

The pinned repository tree contains Neuron-BERT tube-test code and model artifacts but no data_aligned.pkl or FST/TST analysis module. The data-release README names only enriched_habitat and multi_animal_interaction experiments.

The public Figshare v1 API exposes 28 named files (approximately 11.88 GB total); the only files named data_aligned.mat are associated with multi-animal interaction and enriched habitat. Its visible file list contains no tube-test data_aligned.pkl or winner-label file, and no FST/TST aligned data or machine-readable labels.

The public Drive root HTML lists code, enriched_habitat, Multi_animal_interaction, MCU_timestamps, optical_characteristic, raw_recordings, and SAM2_Mice. The unauthenticated raw_recordings folder HTML displayed frames.zip only. This is a public-page listing check, not a full authenticated Drive inventory.

Supplementary Note 4 reports FST three-phase decoding with five-fold AUC 0.957 +/- 0.02 and per-class precision/recall/F1 for struggling, swimming, and floating. It reports TST active/passive SVM accuracy 0.832 +/- 0.055 across four animals. The supplement mentions manually annotated FST behavior in Supplementary Video 10 and TST active/passive motion overlays in Video 11, but these are not identified as machine-readable label tables.

A text search of the public supplement found no definition of whether FST AUC is ROC or PR, nor a multiclass aggregation rule. The published AUC must not be operationalized until that definition is established from first-party methods or code.

social_competition_trial_binary_f1.source_support: Code specifies the sample, winner label orientation, training swap, and binary F1.
missing_public_inputs: Provenance and permitted train/test split for a benchmark release
social_competition_trial_binary_f1.reason: A task contract can be drafted from pinned code, but public source inventory does not expose the labeled trial payload. The published multi-animal data_aligned.mat cannot be assumed equivalent.

forced_swim_phase_auc.source_support: Supplementary Note 4 identifies swimming, struggling, and floating phases and reports an AUC across five folds.
missing_public_inputs: Unit and grouping for independent split
forced_swim_phase_auc.reason: The reported metric is not a sufficiently defined evaluator contract, and labeled input data were not located in the inspected public inventory.

tail_suspension_active_passive_accuracy.source_support: Supplementary Note 4 reports active/passive SVM decoding accuracy across four animals.
tail_suspension_active_passive_accuracy.reason: The public supplement names the label classes and accuracy, but the inspected release inventory does not expose benchmark-ready examples and labels.

inferences_and_limits: Absence from the inspected GitHub tree, Figshare v1 file list, and unauthenticated Drive pages does not prove the research data do not exist elsewhere or cannot be released.
FST AUC is treated as undefined rather than assumed to be ROC AUC or PR AUC.
No 3D, position-regression, or region-classification task is included in this audit batch.
next_action: Keep all three as candidate tasks. Obtain a public first-party manifest or release for each experiment's aligned calcium examples and machine-readable labels; for FST also obtain the exact ROC/PR and multiclass AUC computation before implementing or accepting the task.
